verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's SQL API supports set-based data manipulation (gh-3). Its official MCP server lets AI tools execute statements and insert rows from natural-language prompts (docs-4, docs-28). Backups can cover whole databases or tables (docs-6). Together these imply multi-item operations are possible, but the evidence never documents bulk or batch capabilities explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk import/update/delete or batch operations, bulk actions via the MCP server or ccloud CLI, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
